title: C1 View Query
description: A query that assembles an on-demand context window from a tape. Views are derived, never stored as truth.

since_anchor.description: Include entries from this anchor id onward.

event_names.description: Glob patterns over C2 event names (e.g. redteam.*).

limit.description: Keep at most the last N entries after filtering.

include_superseded.description: If false (default), entries pointed at by a `supersedes` are dropped.
